landing.heroSub: Snap a photo of any prescription and keep it forever. Get smart reminders for medicines, appointments, and checkups — all in one place.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for your health journey
landing.featuresSub: Simple, beautiful tools to organize your medical history and never miss a thing.
landing.feat1Desc: Snap a picture of any paper prescription. No typing needed. We organize everything automatically.
landing.feat2Desc: Browse your complete medical history in a beautiful, searchable timeline. Find anything in seconds.
landing.feat3Desc: Set custom reminders for every medicine. Get notified exactly when it's time to take your dose.
landing.feat4Desc: Search by doctor name, hospital, diagnosis, or medicine. Your entire history at your fingertips.
landing.feat5Desc: Use Wellness in English, Bengali, Spanish, or French. Switch anytime from settings.
landing.feat6Desc: Your data is encrypted and private. Login with just your phone number — no passwords to remember.
landing.howTitle: Four simple steps to better health management
landing.step1Desc: Enter your phone number and verify with a one-time code. No email or password required.
landing.step2Desc: Take photos of paper prescriptions and reports. Add doctor details and medicine names in seconds.
landing.step3Desc: All your records are automatically organized by date. Browse, search, and find anything instantly.
landing.step4Desc: Set reminders for medicines, appointments, and follow-ups. We'll keep you on track, every day.
landing.demoTitle: Your complete health timeline in one beautiful view
landing.demoSub: Every prescription, report, and reminder — organized chronologically. Search by doctor, hospital, or medicine in seconds.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to take control of your health?
landing.ctaSub: Join thousands of people who trust Wellness to keep their medical records organized, accessible, and secure.
landing.footerDesc: Your personal health companion. Store prescriptions, track medicines, and never miss an appointment.
